entries.label: Volgin — combinaison rouge de combat Delta, bras nus
entries.episode: Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater (2025)
entries.canonicalLabelCorrection: Legacy catalogue calls this shirtless-battle. Actual Delta boss references show a short-sleeved red insulating battle suit with bare arms, not a bare torso.
entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create exactly ONE isolated full-body raster production sprite of COLONEL VOLGIN in his final Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater (2025) boss battle outfit, using ONLY the three supplied actual Delta gameplay references for identity and costume. Image 1 is the main precise face/chest/material reference; image 2 is the distant full-body reference; image 3 confirms the lower torso, thigh and knee armor and natural fight stance. He wears a RED INSULATING BATTLE SUIT with short fitted sleeves, NOT a bare torso. Preserve his massive broad-shouldered muscular adult body, short blond military hair, square face, extensive irregular healed scars on face and bare arms, high smooth brass/gold neck ring, red zipped fitted chest with raised curved conduit seams and small round brass contacts, brown padded ribbed panels along the sides, short red sleeves ending in brass/gold rings above the elbows, exposed scarred forearms, bare hands, linked black-and-brass ammunition belt diagonally from his anatomical left shoulder to right hip and additional belt loops around his hips, fitted red thigh panels and red articulated knee/shin armor with red/brown heavy boots as shown. Do not substitute the long military coat, original PS2 model, generic superhero armor, futuristic exosuit, bare chest, or new insignia. Retain the realistic Delta game-render materials and proportions, no cartoon or pixel-art stylization. Pose one entire Volgin in a stable three-quarter combat-ready stance facing screen-right, both feet fully visible, arms naturally held with clenched bare fists, enough separation to inspect the costume. No gun, no electricity or glow that hides details, no effects, no opponent. Entire body from hair to boot soles fully inside a tall canvas with generous true transparent margins. One subject only, no panels or sprite sheet. Genuine RGBA transparency; no background, floor, shadow plane, color matte, checkerboard pixels, UI, text, logo, watermark. Source-faithful static adaptation for external review, not a certified extracted game model.

notes: Combinaison rouge isolante, col et manches cerclés dorés, bras cicatrisés, cartouchières et morphologie massive comparés aux captures Delta.
L'intitulé legacy torse nu est incorrect pour les références consultées et n'est pas présenté comme un fait canonique.
Tête orientée vers la droite après correction; corps et deux bottes entiers. La cartographie précise des cicatrices, les détails de bottes peu résolus et les surfaces non visibles restent à revoir.

entries.label: Diamond Dogs — équipement casque, masque et gilet tactique
entries.episode: Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain (1984)
entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create exactly ONE isolated full-body raster asset of a male DIAMOND DOGS Mother Base soldier wearing the tactical helmet-and-vest equipment from Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain (1984 incarnation), based specifically on the SMALL FULL-BODY SOLDIER IN THE UPPER-RIGHT corner of the supplied official character concept-art sheet. That upper-right figure is the exact costume reference: green/brown tiger-stripe fatigues, close-fitting dark segmented helmet, dark lower-face mask, tactical black/dark charcoal vest with front pouches, shoulder patches, dark forearm protection and gloves, tactical belt and thigh straps, external muted olive knee pads, trousers tucked into olive/black tall military boots. Use the larger figure at left ONLY to understand the same face-mask and helmet construction, boot lacing and anatomy; DO NOT give the result his plain shirt, rolled sleeve or lack of vest. The helmet detail views confirm the original segmented protective cap, not a modern high-cut ballistic helmet. Ignore the yellow-shirt deck crew and doctor completely. This source represents generic Diamond Dogs Mother Base staff; do not invent a separate MGO3 Scout armor, specialist badge, super-suit, camo scheme or extra equipment. Retain the muted olive/brown/charcoal palette, characteristic pouches, silhouette, and original concept design. One adult human soldier only, full body in a neutral combat-ready stance, three-quarter rotation toward SCREEN-RIGHT, nose and feet oriented toward RIGHT side of image, hands empty with relaxed slightly bent elbows. Two arms and legs, all fingers and both whole boots visible. Clean detailed painted raster interpretation of the actual art, readable materials and controlled realistic proportions suitable for a CQC static source sprite; no glossy photorealistic redesign, no chibi form or exaggerated armor. Entire helmet-to-soles figure occupies about 85 percent of portrait frame, safe clear margins on every side. True transparent RGBA background, no white backdrop, floor, shadows, gradient, aura, checkerboard pixels, annotation, logo, caption, panel or second pose. Static reference-guided adaptation pending external fidelity review; not a claim of exact extracted in-game geometry.

notes: La tenue reproduit le personnage entier avec gilet en haut à droite de la planche Motherbase Staff : casque segmenté, masque, tenue camouflage, poches frontales et genouillères.
Scout est une spécialisation de catalogue CQC attribuée à ce corps générique Diamond Dogs; la source n'établit pas une classe officielle distincte ni un modèle MGO3.
Corps entier orienté droite, mains vides, alpha natif conservé; l'emblème et le motif fin doivent être contrôlés avant validation de fidélité.

entries.label: Snake AC!D² — bandages de l'épilogue, posture assise
entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create exactly ONE isolated full-body transparent raster character asset of SNAKE from the hospital epilogue of METAL GEAR AC!D 2 (2005 PSP), based on the TWO supplied actual ending-scene images. Preserve the original illustrated/cel-shaded game character style and muted gray-green medical scene palette; do not modernize into a photorealistic Metal Gear Solid actor. Image 1 gives his complete seated body with companions; image 2 gives a clear frontal view of Snake himself, his face, arm/chest bandages and shorts. Ignore every other person, the separate portrait on the left, all captions and all overlay words. Snake is the adult muscular brown-haired man seated on the bed, NOT the younger men or woman next to him. Preserve his spiky swept-back brown hair, dark stubble beard, tired stern face, white bandage wrapped across the forehead, wide white medical bandages around the abdomen and chest with bare shoulders and upper pectorals, bandage strap over his anatomical right shoulder, bare upper arms, bandaged forearms and hands as visible, short fitted dark gray-green recovery shorts, broad bandages around both mid-thighs with bare knee gaps, and wrapped lower legs and feet from the medical aftermath. No stealth suit, armored boots, camouflage trousers, weapons, new equipment, eye patch or blue headband from his separate normal portrait. Pose him seated in a relaxed supported recovery posture adapted from the source, his body and nose oriented gently three-quarter toward screen-right, elbows bent with one forearm resting on his thigh, both bandaged feet fully visible. His sitting posture remains recognizably medical rather than combat-ready. Isolate only his whole body; omit the bed, room, other characters, furniture and supporting surface. Keep full hair, fingers, both heels and toes inside a portrait canvas with safe transparent margins. Clean coherent drawn anatomy, simple game-illustration shading and the same broad bandage placements visible in the sources. One subject only; no panels, captions, UI, logos or labels. True RGBA transparent background, no floor, shadow plane, halo, colored matte or checkerboard pixels. This is a source-guided isolated-body pose adaptation for external review, not an assertion of exact unseen bandage texture mapping.

notes: Référence visuelle de la scène finale : cheveux bruns, bande frontale blanche, bandages de torse et bras, short sombre, bandages de cuisses et jambes.
La posture médicale assise est conservée et tournée vers la droite; ce n'est pas une posture de combat canonique.
Le lit et les autres personnages sont omis pour obtenir le corps isolé. Les extrémités partiellement cachées par le texte des références sont reconstruites et nécessitent une revue externe.

entries.label: Virgil AT-9 — pod déployé ouvert
entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create exactly ONE isolated full-body raster asset of VIRGIL AT-9 from METAL GEAR SURVIVE in its OPEN / DEPLOYED BASE-CAMP POD configuration, based on the supplied actual game images. Image 1 is the MAIN full-height deployed-form reference: isolate the tall mechanical pod in the CENTER-RIGHT of the image, immediately behind the white interact symbol, NOT the human in foreground, trees, buildings or the smaller devices. The deployed pod is open vertically: preserve the dark charcoal cylindrical lower base with its red-lit horizontal band and folded structural panels, the narrow exposed central mechanical neck/support and circular cage rings, and the tall raised/splayed tapered upper shell parts arranged around the open central column, precisely following the distinctive proportions and silhouette visible in image 1. Image 2 is a detail reference only for the same pod's dark worn metallic finish, red horizontal light bands, round red lens, fasteners and construction; do NOT collapse the open pod into that close-up closed state. This is the original Survive AI pod, not a humanoid robot, generic sci-fi terminal, Peace Walker boss or a redesigned turret. Do not add limbs, guns, extra antenna arrays, screens, crystal decorations, labels or invented insignia. Render a single complete deployed pod from its highest shell tips down to every base foot, clean detailed realistic game-render surfaces, near-front three-quarter view consistent with the main source, enough side shown toward screen-right to read its depth. Maintain the source's restrained dark gray metal and small red illuminated details; lighting neutral enough that every real structural part is inspectable. The white triangular icon in source 1 is GAME UI: omit it entirely. Do not reproduce any HUD, humans, furniture, trees, terrain, cables extending out of frame or background. Whole pod occupies 85 percent of tall frame with safe margins around top and feet. Real transparent RGBA alpha background; no ground plane, cast shadow, glow aura, color matte, drawn checkerboard, text, panels or multiple views. Static source-guided recreation pending external fidelity review, not an exact model extraction. Reconstruct only what is visually supported, do not embellish unseen surfaces.

notes: Configuration ouverte observée dans la capture de base camp : coque supérieure élevée, mécanisme central et anneaux exposés, base sombre à bande rouge.
L'icône blanche d'interaction de la capture est exclue. Un seul pod entier isolé sur alpha.
Les détails mécaniques fins sont limités par la définition du pod dans la capture large; la reconstruction ne constitue pas une géométrie extraite ou certifiée 1:1.
